readout_other: steady-state visual evoked potential amplitude and phase; contrast increment detection psychophysics
direction_notes: No effect of LGN or control-site TUS at any PRF on SSVEP amplitude, latency or contrast-increment detection, online or offline.
safety_notes: No apparent visual percepts or discomfort at the TUS site were reported; BabelBrain thermal simulation gave a maximum temperature rise of 0.5 C at the target.

timing.protocol_description: 12 s trains at 10% duty cycle, PRF randomised trial by trial among 4.875, 48.75 and 487.5 Hz, with 5% linear ramps on the pulses at the two lower PRFs; synchronised with visual stimulus onset; eight 16-trial TUS blocks interleaved with no-TUS trials, depth 70 mm (LGN) or 30 mm (control).

flags.reason: Text says n=25 and 'Twenty-five subjects were retained with 2 rejected', implying 27 enrolled; 25 recorded.
Trains stated as 12 s, but trial text also says 11 s trials and 10.667 s of TUS per 13.333 s trial.
Results give mean simulated in situ Isppa 16.2 W/cm2 (range 8.5-20.5) while the Discussion says about 8 W/cm2 on average at the target.
0.69 +/- 0.33 MPa is a peak negative pressure, with range 0.5-0.78; the SD looks inconsistent with the range.
Control site is described as auditory cortex and subcortical white matter at 30 mm depth; no separate dosimetry reported.
Pulse duration not stated; duty cycle and PRF are given but no arithmetic done.
Mask-only no-TUS trials were also interleaved; whether the transducer was powered off is not stated.
